verdict.rationale: Datadog documents a Dashboards product. Hands-on users confirm that non-developers can build dashboards, that widgets move between dashboards and notebooks, that view state lives in the URL for easy sharing, and they praise its distinctive hexagon map visualization. The pack's Dashboards doc is only a title, so the breadth of visualization types is unproven, and template variables are never mentioned. missing for 10: any evidence of template variables, first-party detail on the range of visualization types and sharing options, and dashboards-as-code definition (e.g., JSON/API/Terraform).

support.subject: As an SRE, I can build shareable dashboards with rich visualization types and template variables

citations.quote: widgets can be moved between dashboards and notebooks, and state lives in the URL so views are easy to share in Slack
Datadog's server hexagon map/chart thingie is something else.
